# Clemio

> Voice-first messenger with real-time translation and accessible communication. "Hören statt Lesen."

Clemio is a mobile-first messaging app focused on voice notes, text-to-speech, voice cloning and real-time translation between chat partners. The app is built for accessibility and people who prefer listening over reading.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product landing page with feature overview, voice demo and onboarding entry points.
- [Install](/install): Instructions for installing the app on iOS, Android, Windows and as a PWA.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Clemio handles personal data, voice recordings, transcripts and third-country processing.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Usage rules, subscription terms and acceptable use.
- [Impressum](/impressum): Legal entity, contact details and liability disclosure (German law).

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Phone-number based sign-in and registration (auth-gated content beyond this point).
